NONE: › able to move your body quickly and easily
› able to think quickly and clearly
› used for describing ways of planning and doing work in which it is understood that making changes as they are needed is an important part of the job
（工作中）見機行事的，反應快速的

example: Monkeys are very agile climbers.
猴子動作敏捷，善於攀爬。
You need to have agile fingers to do this kind of work.
從事這種工作，手指必須非常靈巧。
For a man of 80, he has a remarkably agile mind.
對於一個80歲的老人來說，他才思驚人地敏捷。
The whole world seemed agin him.
好像天底下的人都反對他。

NONE: › the use of popular music to spread political ideas, opinions, or information, or music used in this way
以政治宣傳為目的的音樂（在流行音樂裡融入政治觀點和資訊）

T: › [ T ] to make someone feel worried or angry

I: › [ I ] to argue forcefully, especially in public, in order to achieve a particular type of change
（尤指公開）煽動，鼓動，大聲疾呼

T: › [ T ] specialized chemistry to shake a liquid

example: I didn't want to agitate her by telling her.
我不想告訴她，免得她焦慮。
The unions continue to agitate for higher pay.
工會繼續大聲疾呼要求加薪。
As a young man, he had agitated against the Vietnam war.
他年輕時曾公開反對越南戰爭。
Pour the powder into the solution and agitate it until the powder has dissolved.
將粉末倒入溶液中，攪動到溶解為止。

U: › the situation in which people protest or argue, especially in public, in order to achieve a particular type of change

example: He arrived home in a state of agitation.
他焦慮不安地回到家中。
The anti-war agitation is beginning to worry the government.
反戰宣傳逐漸讓政府開始擔心。

NONE: › disapproving someone who tries to make people take part in protests and political activities, especially ones that cause trouble
（抗議或政治波動中的）煽動者，策動者

example: It is thought that the strike was the work of undercover political agitators.
人們認為罷工背後有秘密政治勢力在煽風點火。

NONE: › (the spreading of) strongly political ideas or arguments expressed especially through plays, art, books, etc.
（尤指透過戲劇、藝術、書籍等進行的）政治宣傳鼓動
